idea-plugin.name: iOS Simulator (Baguette)
idea-plugin.description:
Streams and controls the iOS Simulator inside Android Studio, powered by a bundled Baguette (Apache-2.0). No separate install needed.
  • Multiple resizable device panes side by side
  • Touch, scroll, typing and hardware-key input
  • Home, app switcher, lock, volume, action button, notification center, software keyboard
  • Back gesture buttons for LTR and RTL (Arabic/Hebrew) apps; back and notification gestures work in any rotation
  • Rotate the device or just the view; screenshot, screen recording, dark mode, shake, iPhone Duo hinge
  • Boot and shut down simulators; optionally hides Simulator.app when a run launches it
Requires macOS on Apple Silicon and Xcode 26 (iOS 26 simulators). Intel Macs are not supported.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.3.0
  • Rotate device and rotate view (this window only) as separate, distinct toolbar buttons
  • Back gesture and notification center are now screen-space swipes, so they work in landscape and rotated views
  • Screenshot (as shown), screen recording, dark mode toggle, shake, iPhone Duo hinge poses
  • Removed the landscape/portrait toggle; use rotate device instead
0.2.0
  • Back gesture buttons for LTR and RTL apps; left/right edge drags are now real edge swipes
  • Toolbar: software keyboard, notification center, action button
  • Resizable panes via draggable splitters
  • Tool window auto-grows to fit the device aspect ratio
  • Hide Simulator.app when a run launches it (toggleable)
  • Clear error on unsupported (Intel) CPUs
